title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 路由選單加入 GPT-6-Astra 模型
title.en: Amazon Bedrock Route Picker Adds GPT-6-Astra Model

body.zh-TW: 你在 Amazon Bedrock 雲端環境中調用 Codex 時，挑選模型有了新選項。⟦如同連鎖餐廳在特定分店的點餐機上，正式把最新招牌菜加入螢幕選單，走進指定門市的顧客直接按螢幕就能點選。⟧這項改動涵蓋 Mantle 路由，以及 Runtime 的 global 與 US 路由（route，雲端服務分配請求路徑的通道）。只要連線走這幾條途徑，你就能在模型挑選器（model picker，供手動切換不同 AI 版本的選單）中直接選取 GPT-6-Astra 模型。走 Mantle 或 Runtime 的 global／US 路由時，可在模型挑選器直接選 GPT-6-Astra。
body.en: When calling Codex in the Amazon Bedrock cloud environment, you now have a new option when selecting models. ⟦Much like a chain restaurant officially adding its latest signature dish to the screen menu on ordering kiosks at specific branches, allowing customers entering designated stores to select it directly on the screen.⟧ This change covers the Mantle route as well as Runtime's global and US routes. As long as your connection uses these paths, you can directly select the GPT-6-Astra model in the model picker. When routing through Mantle or Runtime global/US, you can directly choose GPT-6-Astra in the model picker.

title.zh-TW: 修正 GPT-6-Astra 非同步提問指引，改用支援工具且認得純文字限制
title.en: Corrected GPT-6-Astra Guidance for Asynchronous Clarifications to Use Supported Tools and Recognize Text-Only Limits

body.zh-TW: 交給 GPT-6-Astra 的任務如果需求不明確，它在背景發問釐清的流程現在更穩定。這項改動修正了該模型提出非同步釐清問題（asynchronous clarification questions，不中斷手邊工作、在背景等候回覆的提問機制）時的內建指引。現在它會確實呼叫官方受支援的工具（supported tool，環境中明訂可用來向外部發問的功能模組），不再誤用不相容的管道。同時，它也能正確辨識該工具僅接受純文字內容，避免送出不支援的格式而引發錯誤。⟦宛如助理遇到交代不清的待辦事項時，會準確把疑問寫成便條紙投進專用留言箱，不再投錯信箱或塞進格式不符的包裹。⟧
body.en: When tasks assigned to GPT-6-Astra have unclear requirements, its process for asking clarifying questions in the background is now more reliable. This change corrects the model's built-in guidance when asking asynchronous clarification questions. It now properly calls officially supported tools instead of misusing incompatible channels. At the same time, it correctly recognizes that the tool accepts only plain text, avoiding errors caused by sending unsupported formats. ⟦Much like an assistant dealing with an unclearly explained task who accurately writes questions on a memo note and drops it into a dedicated message box, rather than dropping it into the wrong mailbox or stuffing in a parcel with an incompatible format.⟧

items.original: Corrected GPT-6-Astra’s guidance for asynchronous clarification questions to use the supported tool and recognize that it accepts text only. (#42809)

title.zh-TW: 更正 GPT-6-Astra Fast 方案描述，文字標明 2 倍速度與更高用量
title.en: Correct GPT-6-Astra Fast tier description to state 2x speed and increased usage

body.zh-TW: 你在挑選模型方案時，會發現 GPT-6-Astra Fast 等級的說明文字有了修正。現在介面會明確標示為「 2x speed, increased usage 」（ 2 倍速度並提高使用量），取代先前寫著的 1.5 倍標示。這項改動純粹是介面文字顯示的勘誤，背後實際發送請求與模型運作的方式維持原樣，執行效能並沒有任何改變。⟦好比快遞門市把海報上的特快配送標籤從 1.5 倍更正為 2 倍，車隊的送貨路線與行車速度始終如一，只是把印錯的宣傳字樣換成正確內容。⟧因此看到介面數字調整時無需擔心，所有指令與請求依然維持既有方式正常運作。
body.en: When selecting model tiers, you will notice an updated description for the GPT-6-Astra Fast tier. The interface now clearly displays "2x speed, increased usage" instead of the previous "1.5x" label. This update is strictly a correction to the displayed text; how requests are sent and how the model operates behind the scenes remain identical, with no change to runtime performance. ⟦It is like a courier branch correcting a poster label for express delivery from 1.5x to 2x; the fleet's delivery routes and driving speeds remain unchanged, simply replacing the misprinted promotional wording with the accurate text.⟧ Therefore, there is no need for concern when seeing the adjusted numbers in the interface, as all commands and requests continue to function normally as before.

title.zh-TW: API 支援指定 GPT-6-Astra，不改預設也不進選單
title.en: Support specifying GPT-6-Astra via API without changing defaults or appearing in the picker

body.zh-TW: 如果你透過 API 串接 Codex 跑程式，現在可以直接在呼叫時指定使用 GPT-6-Astra 模型。它既不會動到你日常使用的預設模型，也不會出現在模型挑選器（model picker，供手動切換模型的選單）裡面。這讓需要特定模型的後端腳本能順利運作，一般在介面挑模型的人看不到這個選項。⟦這就像餐廳為外燴訂單開放私房菜色，廚房能照單出菜，但大廳的常態菜單與櫃檯點餐看板依然維持原樣，不必擔心常客點餐時眼花。⟧
body.en: If you connect to Codex via API to run code, you can now specify the GPT-6-Astra model directly in your API calls. It will neither modify your everyday default model nor appear in the model picker (the menu for manually switching models). This allows backend scripts requiring a specific model to run smoothly without exposing the option to users selecting models in the interface. ⟦It is like a restaurant offering off-menu specialties exclusively for catering orders: the kitchen prepares them as requested, while the dining hall's regular menu and ordering board remain unchanged, preventing regular diners from getting confused when ordering.⟧

items.original: Added support for configuring GPT-6-Astra through the API without changing the default model or showing it in the model picker. (#42605)

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式加了復原與重做，草稿手滑也不怕
title.en: Vim mode adds undo and redo to safeguard draft edits

body.zh-TW: 你在 Vim 模式（改用鍵盤符號下指令的編輯方式，名字來自一款老牌文字編輯器）裡改草稿，手滑刪掉一整段附件說明，以前只能重打——現在按 `u` 就能復原上一步，按 `Ctrl+R` 則是反悔剛才的復原、重做回去，⟦好比用可擦筆寫稿，寫錯了擦掉重寫，擦太多了再把擦掉的字描回來，紙面痕跡都還在⟧。而且不管草稿裡貼了多少內容、掛了幾個附件，復原跟重做都會保留完整版本，不會漏東漏西，你不用擔心救回來的稿子少了一塊。
body.en: When modifying drafts in Vim mode, accidentally deleting a section of attachment notes previously required retyping the whole piece. You can now press `u` to undo the last action and `Ctrl+R` to redo, reversing the undo operation. ⟦It is like writing with an erasable pen: when you make a mistake, you erase and rewrite, and if you erase too much, you can trace the erased strokes right back on the clean paper.⟧ Furthermore, regardless of how much content was pasted or how many attachments were included, undo and redo preserve the complete state without dropping parts of your draft.

items.original: Vim mode now supports undo with `u` and redo with `Ctrl+R`, preserving complete drafts including pasted content and attachments. ([#41941](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41941), [#42140](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42140))

The plugin CLI now connects directly to remote marketplaces: you can run a command to list available plugins, install a chosen plugin with a single command, or remove it just as easily when no longer needed, all without leaving your terminal. ⟦It is like a tool rental shop putting its entire catalog online, allowing you to browse available tools on screen, check them out with a click, and return them when finished without ever flipping through paper lists at the counter.⟧

items.original: The plugin CLI can list, install, and remove plugins from remote marketplaces. ([#42150](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42150))

title.zh-TW: 自動回顧能關掉，貼上偵測開關搬了新家
title.en: Automatic recaps can be disabled and paste-burst settings move to nested keys

body.zh-TW:
想關掉自動回顧摘要，或把貼上大量文字的偵測設定搬到新位置，這裡有兩個新設定鍵。Codex 原本會自動生成回顧摘要，如果你只想在打 `/recap` 時自己叫出來，設定檔加一行：
```
{"tui": {"auto_recap": false}}
```
也就是 `tui.auto_recap = false`，自動摘要關掉，手動 `/recap` 照樣能用。另一個是貼上偵測（paste burst，短時間內貼上大量文字的辨識機制）設定鍵搬家，改用巢狀寫法：
```
{"tui": {"disable_paste_burst": true}}
```
也就是 `tui.disable_paste_burst`，而舊的頂層寫法目前仍當備援繼續有效，不用急著改。⟦彷彿車上的語音路況提示，能直接在中控台整個關掉、改成按鍵才報路況，開關位置也從儀表板搬進了選單，老車主熟悉的實體按鈕暫時還留著備用。⟧
body.en:
This release introduces two new configuration keys for managing recap behavior and paste detection. Codex previously generated recap summaries automatically. If you prefer to trigger recaps manually with `/recap`, add the following line to your configuration file:
```
{"tui": {"auto_recap": false}}
```
This sets `tui.auto_recap = false`, disabling automatic generation while keeping manual `/recap` invocations available. Additionally, the paste burst detection setting has moved to a nested structure:
```
{"tui": {"disable_paste_burst": true}}
```
This introduces `tui.disable_paste_burst`, while the legacy top-level key continues to work as a fallback so immediate migration is not required. ⟦It is like a car audio traffic announcement that can be turned off entirely in favor of an on-demand button, with the toggle relocated from the physical dashboard into a digital menu while the familiar dashboard button still works as a backup.⟧

items.original:
Set `tui.auto_recap = false` to disable automatic recaps while keeping manual `/recap` available. ([#42101](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42101))
`tui.disable_paste_burst` replaces the top-level setting, which remains supported as a fallback. ([#41976](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41976))

title.zh-TW: 對話回頭看更清楚，改了什麼、下了什麼指令都留底
title.en: TUI history displays complete patches, background inputs, and individual commands

body.zh-TW: 回頭捲動 Codex 的終端機介面歷史紀錄時，現在看得到的東西更完整了：程式碼修改會顯示完整的補丁（patch，改動前後對照的差異紀錄），送進背景終端機視窗的輸入內容會留底，個別執行完的指令也各自獨立顯示，不會被吞掉或混成一團。⟦宛如工地的施工日誌，每天不是只寫一句「有動工」，而是附上動工前後的對照照片，還把當天下的每一道工序分開記錄，事後翻查一看就懂哪一步做了什麼。⟧
body.en: Scrolling back through TUI history in Codex now provides a much clearer view of past actions. Code modifications display complete patch diffs, inputs sent to background terminal sessions are fully recorded, and individual completed commands appear distinctly without being omitted or merged together. ⟦It is like a construction site log that includes before-and-after photos alongside separated step-by-step records for each task rather than just noting that work occurred, making every past change immediately obvious when reviewed.⟧

items.original: TUI history shows complete patches, input sent to background terminals, and individual completed commands. ([#41893](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41893), [#42107](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42107))

title.zh-TW: 額度剩不到一半，Plus 跟 Team 會提早跟你說
title.en: Plus and Team plans receive earlier alerts when usage drops below half

body.zh-TW: 用 Plus 或 Team 方案的人，額度用得快不快，現在能更早知道。以前要等額度更接近用完才會收到提醒，常常是打到一半才發現要沒了。現在只要在大約五小時一輪的用量視窗裡，額度剩不到一半，就會提早跳出警告，你就有機會提前調整步調，不必臨時改變工作方式。⟦恰似手上剩的洗衣券只剩不到一半時，機台先跳出提醒，讓你有空檔想要不要趕在額度重置前多洗一輪，而不是洗到最後一刻才發現券快用完。⟧
body.en: Subscribers on Plus and Team plans can now gauge their quota consumption earlier. While warnings were previously triggered only as allowances were nearly exhausted, alerts are now sent as soon as less than half of the allowance remains within an approximately five-hour usage window. This gives you time to pace your prompts without having to abruptly adjust your workflow. ⟦It is like a laundry machine displaying an early reminder when fewer than half of your laundry coupons remain, giving you time to plan an extra load before your allowance resets rather than discovering you are out of coupons at the very last moment.⟧

items.original: Plus and Team users receive an earlier warning when less than half of their allowance remains in an approximately five-hour usage window. ([#42142](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42142))

title.zh-TW: 外部連線斷了會自動接回來，未確定的動作先暫停等你看
title.en: External app-server drops reconnect automatically while pending submissions pause for review

body.zh-TW: 你透過外部的 app-server（讓其他程式跟 Codex 對話的伺服器介面）連線用 Codex，這條連線如果突然斷掉，⟦就像視訊會議斷線重連，畫面接回來的時候，你正在打的訊息草稿還在、對話紀錄也沒不見，只是原本正在表決的提案先暫停，等你確認才繼續⟧。具體來說，Codex 現在會自動重新連上這個外部 app-server，草稿跟對話轉錄（transcript，逐字紀錄）都完整保留。而斷線當下還不確定有沒有送出、或是還在排隊等處理的動作，會先暫停下來，交給你重新確認過再繼續，不會替你自作主張。
body.en: When using Codex through an external app-server connection that suddenly drops, ⟦it is like a video conference reconnecting after a network drop, where your draft chat messages and previous chat logs are intact while an ongoing poll is paused until you confirm how to proceed⟧. Codex now automatically reconnects to the external app-server, preserving drafts and conversation transcripts intact. Any submissions that were in-flight or queued when the connection dropped are held in a paused state for user review before proceeding.

items.original: TUI sessions reconnect after an external app-server connection drops, preserving drafts and transcripts while keeping uncertain or queued submissions paused for review. ([#41911](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41911), [#41916](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41916), [#41918](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41918))

title.zh-TW: 審查跳過該跳的，該顧的紀錄一樣顧著
title.en: Guardian skips unnecessary reviews while preserving history across rollbacks and forks

body.zh-TW: Codex 的 Guardian（把關風險動作的審查機制）這次分清該管與不管的界線。用 Full Access（完全授權模式）時，遇到只需按確認的動作，Guardian 現在直接跳過審查。換成每個動作都要核准的 User approval mode，Guardian 也不再背景幫提案打分數、預先熱機，但敏感動作檢查與需要你輸入答案的請求，處理方式不變。Guardian 過去審過的紀錄也扛得住考驗：對話被壓縮、程式重啟，或你自己開了分支，紀錄都留得住，仍遵守回捲（rollback，把狀態退回先前某刻）的邊界。子代理（subagent，替它跑某段子任務的分身）的歷史也被隔開，不會混進主線程。⟦宛如社區警衛登記訪客，熟面孔的住戶刷卡就放行、不必每次登記，陌生訪客照樣得留資料才能進去；警衛室的登記簿就算搬家、換班，甚至臨時開了側門，各戶訪客紀錄還是分開保管，不會混成一本。⟧
body.en: Guardian reviews in Codex now feature clearer operational boundaries. In Full Access mode, Guardian skips reviews for confirmation-only actions. When running in User approval mode, it stops background proposal scoring and prewarming while preserving existing checks for sensitive actions and user input requests. Furthermore, Guardian review histories now survive compaction, application restarts, and user-created forks while strictly respecting rollback boundaries and isolating subagent history from the main thread. ⟦It is like a residential security guard waving recognized residents through without repeated paperwork while still logging outside visitors, keeping visitor logbooks organized and isolated even across desk moves, shift changes, or side-door entries.⟧

title.zh-TW: 上下文管理實驗模式預設關閉，開通後才會啟用新工具
title.en: Context management experimental mode is disabled by default and enables new tools when activated

body.zh-TW:
Codex 新增了一個預設關閉的實驗設定 `features.context_management.experimental_mode`，如果你符合資格想試，在設定檔加上：
```
{"features": {"context_management": {"experimental_mode": true}}}
```
也就是把這個巢狀設定鍵打開。開啟後，如果你是用 Codex 後端的 ChatGPT Plus、Pro 或 Pro Lite 訂閱、而且帳號被納入資格名單，就會啟用以 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）預算管理上下文的機制，外加歷史筆記功能跟 `new_context` 這個工具。用 API 金鑰（一組用來證明身分、直接呼叫底層服務的密碼字串）登入的工作階段、自訂供應商，以及暫時性的結構化執行緒，則不在開放範圍內，不會啟用這些新機制。⟦有點像新開的試營運方案，只開放給符合資格、事先報名的特定會員試用新設施，臨櫃辦的訪客卡跟外接廠商暫時還用不到。⟧
body.en:
Codex introduces the disabled-by-default `features.context_management.experimental_mode` configuration setting. To try it when eligible, add the following snippet to your configuration file:
```
{"features": {"context_management": {"experimental_mode": true}}}
```
When enabled for eligible ChatGPT Plus, Pro, or Pro Lite sessions using the Codex backend, it activates token-budgeted context management, history notes, and the `new_context` tool. API-key sessions, custom providers, and temporary structured threads remain excluded from these new capabilities. ⟦It is like a pilot trial program that grants access to new amenities only to pre-registered eligible members, while day-pass visitors and outside contractors are not included yet.⟧

title.zh-TW: 帳號、路徑、續接紀錄，一批後台細節一次補上
title.en: Refined account scoping, path handling, and session resumes across backend features

body.zh-TW: 這批修復收攏了幾項後台細節。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具的核准記憶改成綁定帳號，換帳號不會沿用另一個帳號核准過的設定；MCP 相對路徑執行檔，在 macOS 上啟動更可靠。對話紀錄壓縮現在併入共享歷史，`codex exec resume` 依目錄續接也認得壓縮過的紀錄。工作階段的根目錄就算是符號連結（symlink，指到別處的捷徑檔），開執行緒分支照樣正常。app-server 執行緒中繼資料多了可為空值的 `model`、`reasoningEffort` 欄位，模型目錄若開放，還能用 `request_user_input_async` 結構化、非同步發問，不必卡住等你即答。⟦如同寄放行李，寄放單跟存根號碼要對得上才能領回，就算行李轉去別的置物櫃，存根照樣領得到東西，連加保險也能先發通知單，不必現場答。⟧
body.en: This release refines several backend implementation details. Remembered MCP tool approvals are now scoped to the active account so switching accounts will not reuse permissions granted by another user, and relative MCP executable paths launch more reliably on macOS. Rollout compression now incorporates shared histories, allowing `codex exec resume` to handle compressed rollouts when resuming by working directory, while thread forks operate cleanly with symlinked session roots. Additionally, app-server thread metadata includes nullable `model` and `reasoningEffort` fields, and `request_user_input_async` enables structured asynchronous prompts when supported by the model catalog. ⟦It is like checking luggage where the claim ticket must match the account holder to retrieve bags, items remain retrievable even if moved between storage lockers, and additional insurance notices can be sent for later review without requiring an immediate answer on the spot.⟧

entries: Guardian approval review now honors Node REPL policies provided through model metadata.

title.zh-TW: 批准審查會照模型帶來的 Node REPL 規定判斷
title.en: Approval review now follows the Node REPL policies the model provides

body.zh-TW: ⟦實驗室的器材借用規定寫在器材本身的說明卡上，管理員照那張卡放行；以前卡片擺在那裡卻沒人看，管理員只按自己那套老規矩辦。⟧Codex 的 Guardian 批准審查（動手做事前先判斷這件事該不該放行的關卡）現在會遵守模型 metadata 裡帶的 Node REPL 政策。metadata 是隨模型一起送來、描述它自身的一小份資料；Node REPL 則是直接輸入一行 JavaScript 就立刻執行的互動環境。換句話說，該不該放行這類指令，依據來自模型自己聲明的那份規定，而不是審查關卡自行認定。
body.en: ⟦A lab keeps the rules for borrowing a piece of equipment on the card attached to it, and the keeper follows that card; before, the card sat there unread and the keeper went by their own old habits.⟧ Codex's Guardian approval review, the gate that decides whether an action may go ahead, now honors the Node REPL policies provided through model metadata. Metadata is the small description that travels with a model, and a Node REPL is the interactive prompt where a line of JavaScript runs the moment you type it. In other words, whether such a command is allowed through comes from the rules the model itself declares, not from what the review gate decides on its own.

items.original: Guardian approval review now honors Node REPL policies provided through model metadata.

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式能在草稿裡搜尋，新草稿直接能打字
title.en: Vim mode supports in-draft search and starts fresh drafts ready for typing

body.zh-TW: 你在 Codex 的輸入框切到 Vim 模式（改用鍵盤符號下指令與搜尋的編輯方式，名字來自一款老牌文字編輯器）改一段長草稿，想找回前面提到的某個檔名，以前得整段慢慢往回捲——現在按 `/` 往下找、`?` 往上找，符合的字會被反白標出來，找到了按 `n` 跳下一個、`N` 跳回上一個，⟦就像拿螢光筆把整篇稿子裡同一個詞全部畫記，之後沿著螢光筆的痕跡一路跳，不用逐行盯著找⟧。另外，每次開新草稿，游標現在直接能打字：不管是剛送出一則訊息，還是打完斜線指令（`/` 開頭觸發的內建指令）後接著開新的一段，都不用再手動切換才能輸入。
body.en: When editing long drafts in Vim mode within the Codex composer, finding an earlier filename no longer requires manual scrolling. You can now press `/` to search forward or `?` to search backward with highlighted matches, and navigate with `n` and `N` to jump between occurrences. ⟦It works like marking every instance of a word with a highlighter and jumping directly between highlighted marks instead of scanning line by line.⟧ Furthermore, fresh drafts now start directly ready for typing: whether you just submitted a message or ran a slash command, you can start typing immediately without manually switching modes.

title.zh-TW: 用量卡住了，橫幅上直接能查能管
title.en: Rate-limit banners let you check usage and manage limits directly

body.zh-TW: 被限流（rate limit，用量到頂被暫時擋下）擋下來的時候，以前只會看到一條乾巴巴的橫幅告訴你現在不能用，接下來要自己想辦法。現在這條橫幅上直接放了幾個按鈕：查目前用量、管理額度、重設限制、管理訂閱方案，點哪個就辦哪件事，不必先關掉提示再去別的地方翻設定。⟦好比汽車油表亮燈時，旁邊直接排著加油站導航、加值卡餘額、延長保固幾個按鈕，不用先熄火下車才找得到辦法。⟧
body.en: When hit by a rate limit, users previously saw only a plain banner stating that requests were temporarily blocked, leaving them to figure out the next step on their own. The banner now includes direct action buttons to check current usage, manage credits, reset limits, and manage subscription plans, allowing you to handle each task immediately without dismissing the alert to search through settings. ⟦It is like a low-fuel warning light on a dashboard that displays buttons for gas station navigation, prepaid card balance, and extended warranty right beside it, rather than forcing you to pull over and step out of the car to find help.⟧

items.original: Rate-limit banners offer actions for checking usage, managing credits, resetting limits, and managing plans. (#41742)

title.zh-TW: 重新登入卡住不再是一片空白，進度會秀出來
title.en: Reauthentication progress is now visible in the terminal UI and codex exec

body.zh-TW: 終端機介面跟 `codex exec` 這個非互動指令，現在會即時顯示憑證（credential，證明你是合法使用者的金鑰）更新到哪一步了，連透過 Amazon Bedrock 重新認證這種比較繞的流程也一樣有進度可看。以前遇到需要重新拿授權，畫面往往就是卡住不動，你根本不知道它是在處理還是當機了。⟦彷彿機場的自助通關閘門，以前刷證件後螢幕一片黑，不知道是在核對還是壞了；現在畫面會顯示「正在核對指紋」「正在確認資料」，一步步走到綠燈放行。⟧
body.en: The terminal UI and the non-interactive `codex exec` command now display live progress when refreshing credentials, including multi-step flows like Amazon Bedrock reauthentication. Previously, reauthentication would leave the screen hanging with no feedback, making it impossible to tell whether the process was working or frozen. ⟦It is like an automated airport immigration gate where the screen previously went black after scanning an ID, but now displays step-by-step progress like "verifying fingerprints" and "confirming details" until the green light lets you through.⟧

items.original: The terminal UI and `codex exec` show credential-refresh progress, including Amazon Bedrock reauthentication. (#41239)

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器名字可以照套件格式取，工具輸出也能設上限
title.en: MCP server names support package formats, and tool outputs can set limits

body.zh-TW: MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器的名稱以前只能用簡單字元。現在可以放 `:`、`@`、`/`、`.` 這些符號，等於能照套件命名慣例取名，像 `@scope/name` 這種寫法，指令列跟認證流程全部認得。同時，個別 MCP 工具現在能設定 `output_token_limit`，限制單次輸出的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限，而且不管你怎麼把工作階段接回來繼續用，這個截斷規則都會維持一致。⟦一如社區信箱從只能貼三碼門牌，改成可以掛完整地址加樓層，而每一格信箱的容量也能各自標好，不會有人塞爆別人的格子。⟧
body.en: MCP server names were previously limited to simple characters. They can now include `:`, `@`, `/`, and `.`, enabling standard package-style naming such as `@scope/name` across all CLI commands and authentication flows. In addition, individual MCP tools now support an `output_token_limit` setting to cap output tokens per invocation, maintaining consistent truncation rules across resumed sessions. ⟦It is like apartment mailboxes upgrading from three-digit numbers to full addresses with floor numbers, while also setting individual capacity limits so no single delivery overflows someone else's box.⟧

title.zh-TW: 規劃工具改成預設關閉，要用得自己在設定裡打開
title.en: The planning tool is now disabled by default and requires explicit configuration

body.zh-TW:
以前 Codex 會內建一個規劃工具，現在這個功能改成預設不啟用。如果你要用，得自己在設定檔裡加上這一段：

```
{"tools": {"update_plan": {"enabled": true}}}
```

也就是把 `tools.update_plan.enabled` 設成 `true`。這不是新推出的功能，而是把原本一律開著的東西收緊成選用項目。⟦有點像家電出廠時把耗電的附加功能先關掉，想用得自己翻說明書、在面板上按一下才會亮起來。⟧
body.en:
Codex previously enabled its built-in planning tool out of the box, but the feature is now disabled by default. To use it, you must add the following snippet to your configuration file:

```
{"tools": {"update_plan": {"enabled": true}}}
```

This sets `tools.update_plan.enabled` to `true`. Rather than introducing a new feature, this update makes an existing capability opt-in. ⟦It is like an appliance shipping with power-hungry optional modes turned off, requiring you to check the manual and press a button on the panel to turn them on.⟧

items.original: The planning tool is disabled by default; enable it with `tools.update_plan.enabled = true`. (#41744)

title.zh-TW: 自動審查不再健忘，壓縮歷史也留得住授權
title.en: Automatic approval reviews retain longer transcripts and preserve authorizations across compaction

body.zh-TW: 自動批准的審查機制這次補強了記性。以前訊息一長、對話一多，審查能保留的內容就有限，現在可以留住更長的訊息，也能看見更大範圍的對話轉錄（transcript，對話的逐字紀錄）。更關鍵的是，就算對話因為太長被系統壓縮（compaction，把舊對話濃縮成摘要以節省空間），使用者當初下的指示、給過的答案，以及已經核可的有效授權，都不會被壓縮掉，審查時仍然找得到依據。⟦如同開庭留下的卷宗，就算檔案疊得再厚要精簡歸檔，當事人的證詞跟簽過名的授權書也不會被摘要掉，日後翻案還是查得到原文。⟧
body.en: Automatic approval reviews now retain richer conversation context. While earlier reviews were limited when handling lengthy exchanges, the system can now hold longer messages and larger conversation transcripts. Crucially, when conversations undergo history compaction to condense past turns, original user instructions, provided answers, and granted authorizations are preserved rather than compressed away, ensuring reviews retain full context. ⟦It is like a court case file where older records are archived into summaries, but key testimony and signed authorization forms are preserved intact so original records remain verifiable later.⟧

items.original:
Automatic approval reviews can retain longer messages and a larger conversation transcript. (#41931)
Automatic approval reviews preserve user instructions, answers, and valid authorizations across history compaction. (#41660, #41846, #41852)

title.zh-TW: 背景動作各自照規矩來，續接、快取跟選單都更牢靠
title.en: Background operations refined across thread resumption, caching, and model menus

body.zh-TW: 這批修復把幾個容易在背景出包的地方一次補齊。app-server 的客戶端現在能自己設定 `thread/shellCommand` 的逾時時間，就算要等超過一小時也設得了；把之前的工作階段接回來繼續用時，沒特別指定路徑就會自動還原成上次的工作目錄，客戶端更新描述資訊也不會動到原本的檔案系統權限。MCP 工具在快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）更新、遠端外掛換版本時仍然能正常呼叫。認證要重試時，也會換上輔助程式剛給的新標頭（headers，請求裡帶的驗證資訊）。開模型選單重新整理清單時，原本反白選著的那個也不會跳掉。外掛推薦則是改成開機時就先載入，不用等到你打第一句才臨時去抓。⟦像看電影中途離席，回來時票根還夾在原位、放映沒斷、燈亮了位子照樣是你的；寄放的外套、預訂的爆米花、留在櫃檯的加購單也都還在，沒有哪一樣因為你走開就作廢。⟧
body.en: This release fixes multiple background edge cases. Clients connecting to app-server can now configure `thread/shellCommand` timeouts, including deadlines longer than one hour. Resumed threads automatically restore their previous working directory when none is specified, and client metadata updates preserve existing filesystem permissions. In addition, MCP tools remain callable during cache refreshes and remote plugin updates, while authentication retries adopt newly refreshed helper headers. Opening the model picker refreshes the model list without losing your currently selected item, and plugin recommendations begin loading at startup to minimize delays before the first prompt. ⟦It is like stepping out during a movie and returning to find your ticket stub in place, the projection running, your seat held, and your coat, pre-ordered popcorn, and counter receipt all waiting without anything expiring while you were away.⟧

title.zh-TW: Windows 三個毛病修好，雲端任務也不聽陌生網址的話
title.en: Three Windows fixes resolved and cloud tasks reject untrusted URLs

body.zh-TW: Windows 上有三個毛病一次修掉：用 Microsoft Store 版 PowerShell 執行沙盒（sandbox，限制程式能碰哪些檔案與網路的隔離環境）會出錯、查詢終端機狀態時子行程可能整個卡住、還有舊版 JediTerm 終端機的游標顯示會花掉。另外，雲端任務現在會擋下不受信任的後端網址，也停用自動轉址，避免存好的憑證被騙去傳給不該收到的地方。⟦宛如一批同時故障的門禁刷卡機跟顯示面板，維修人員一台台拆開修好，順便把只認得掛牌廠商的規矩重新鎖緊，陌生人拿著奇怪的卡靠近也刷不開。⟧
body.en: Three issues on Windows have been resolved in this release: sandbox execution errors with Microsoft Store PowerShell, subprocess hangs during terminal queries, and cursor-related display corruption in older JediTerm terminals. In addition, cloud task requests now reject untrusted backend URLs and disable automatic redirects to prevent saved credentials from being leaked to unintended destinations. ⟦It is like repairing a batch of malfunctioning access card readers and display panels, while tightening gate rules to only recognize certified vendors so unrecognized cards cannot open the gate.⟧

title.zh-TW: 為非必要 MCP 伺服器的工具搜尋新增可自訂的寬限期
title.en: Add configurable grace period for optional MCP server tool discovery

body.zh-TW: ⟦好比會議主持人給線上連線的外部專家預留彈性的報到緩衝，不會因為網路稍慢就直接跳過對方的名額。⟧在連接選用或非必要的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，若外部工具啟動稍慢，搜尋流程不再立刻判定逾時。系統為非必要 MCP 伺服器的工具探索過程新增了可自訂的 grace period（寬限期，等待回應的緩衝時間）。當你掛載需要暖機或遠端連線的擴充伺服器時，可自行設定等待寬限時間，讓所有外部工具都有充裕時間完成註冊。

Codex introduces a configurable grace period for discovering tools from optional MCP servers. This gives background or remote servers enough time to complete initialization and register their tools.

title.zh-TW: 擴充套件可在 MCP 工具回傳結果送交模型前檢查或替換內容
title.en: Extensions can inspect or replace MCP tool results before reaching the model

body.zh-TW: 需要過濾敏感資料或微調工具輸出格式的開發者，現在能在資料管線中精準介入。擴充套件獲得了在 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具執行完畢後、回傳結果尚未送交模型之前，先行檢視或替換該結果的能力。你可以藉此檢查輸出的資料結構，或在必要時抽換回傳內容，避免原始雜訊或機密資訊直接進入模型的提示詞脈絡。⟦這宛如報社的審稿編輯在記者交稿後、正式排版送印前先進行校對與篩選，確保刊登內容完全合規。⟧
body.en: Developers who need to sanitize tool outputs or adjust formats can now intercept data directly in the pipeline. Extensions can now inspect or replace MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool execution results before they are delivered to the model. This allows custom logic to filter out sensitive data or rewrite payload structures before the model processes them. ⟦It is like a copy editor reviewing a reporter's draft before it heads to the printing press, ensuring all published material is properly checked.⟧

items.original: Extensions can now inspect or replace MCP tool results before they reach the model. (#41202)

title.zh-TW: 外掛目錄合併個別儲存庫設定，回報無效市集且不隱藏有效外掛
title.en: Plugin catalogs combine repository configs and report invalid marketplaces

body.zh-TW: 在專案中管理多個外掛來源時，外掛目錄的設定整合變得更加周全。外掛目錄現在會主動合併各個儲存庫（repository，存放專案程式碼與歷史紀錄的目錄）的個別設定。同時，當專案中存在格式錯誤或無法連線的無效市集（marketplace）時，系統會明確回報該問題，而不會因此隱藏其他正常可用的有效外掛。這讓你在排除特定市集故障時，依然能順暢存取其餘工具。⟦像商場把各櫃位各自提供的資料合併成一張總導覽；其中一櫃資料失效時標出問題，其他店舖仍照常列出。⟧
body.en: Managing plugin sources across projects is now much more reliable. Plugin catalogs now combine per-repository configuration into their listings. Furthermore, when a project contains an invalid marketplace, the system reports the issue clearly without hiding the remaining valid plugins. You can troubleshoot broken marketplace links while continuing to use all working extensions. ⟦a mall directory combining each shop’s details into one board, flagging one invalid listing while keeping the other shops visible.⟧

items.original: Plugin catalogs now combine per-repository configuration and report invalid project marketplaces without hiding valid plugins. (#41208)

title.zh-TW: 在終端介面中保留還原的權限設定檔，並防止 /cd 削弱沙盒限制
title.en: Preserve restored permission profiles in TUI and prevent /cd sandbox weakening

body.zh-TW: ⟦如同進入管制大樓時核發的通行證，在跨樓層走動時始終維持原有權限等級，且換到隔壁房間也絕不會意外解除安全門禁。⟧在終端機互動操作時，安全防護的連貫性獲得了加強。在 TUI（終端機使用者介面，在純文字終端裡操作的互動畫面）的多輪對話中，系統現在會妥善保留先前還原的權限設定檔。這些 permission profiles 不會在下一輪對話中遺失狀態。此外，當在對話中執行 `/cd` 指令切換目錄時，系統會嚴格防止沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行範圍的防護機制）的存取限制被削弱，確保邊界防護不留漏洞。
body.en: ⟦It is like a building security badge that maintains your verified clearance across different floors, ensuring that stepping into an adjacent room never disables door locks.⟧ Security consistency in the terminal interface is now reinforced. Restored permission profiles are properly preserved across turns in the TUI (terminal user interface). Switching directories using the `/cd` command is strictly prevented from loosening or bypassing active sandbox restrictions, keeping execution boundaries intact.

items.original: Preserved restored permission profiles across TUI turns and prevented `/cd` from weakening sandbox restrictions. (#41192)

title.zh-TW: 切換或備援至其他模型時正確維持工具可用性與推理強度
title.en: Keep tool availability and reasoning effort correct across model switches and fallbacks

body.zh-TW: 在對話中更換使用的 AI 模型時，工具配置與推論參數不再出現錯亂。當你手動切換模型，或是觸發 fallback（備援，改用另一個模型接手）機制時，目標模型的工具可用性都會被精確維持。同時，模型進行深度思考的 reasoning effort（推理強度，思考運算量的設定）也會維持正確。這避免了切換後工具清單遺失或推論設定不相容的情況。⟦正如賽車進站更換不同特性的輪胎時，技師團隊會同步調校儀表數據與底盤設定，確保換胎後車輛操控完全精準。⟧
body.en: Switching models mid-task no longer disrupts tool setups or reasoning levels. When you manually switch models or trigger a fallback to an alternative model, Codex now keeps tool availability and reasoning effort aligned with the target model. This prevents tools from vanishing unexpectedly and ensures reasoning parameters remain valid for the active provider. ⟦It is like a pit crew changing a race car's tires while instantly recalibrating dashboard telemetry and suspension to match the new setup.⟧

items.original: Kept tool availability and reasoning effort correct when switching models or falling back to another model. (#41195, #41206)

title.zh-TW: 依據遠端執行器的家目錄、作業系統與路徑慣例強化沙盒防護
title.en: Improve remote sandbox enforcement using actual executor environment details

body.zh-TW: 在遠端主機上隔離執行指令時，沙盒的邊界檢查現在完全貼合目標環境的真實狀態。系統強化了遠端沙盒（sandbox，隔離執行範圍的安全機制）的防護。權限判定改為直接依據遠端執行器實際的家目錄（home directory）、作業系統以及路徑慣例進行計算。這消除了本機與遠端主機因斜線方向或大小寫等格式差異而產生的判定偏差。⟦彷彿海關邊檢直接依照入境國當地的法規與道路標誌核查車輛，而非套用出發地的規則，落實了精確的在地把關。⟧
body.en: Running commands in remote environments now benefits from accurate isolation boundaries. Remote sandbox enforcement now aligns with the executor's actual home directory, operating system, and path conventions. This eliminates authorization discrepancies caused by mismatched path separators, root structures, or platform conventions between local and remote hosts. ⟦It is like a customs border checkpoint inspecting vehicles according to the destination country's road rules rather than the departure location's laws.⟧

items.original: Improved remote sandbox enforcement using the executor’s actual home directory, operating system, and path conventions. (#41196, #41204, #41207, #41209)

title.zh-TW: 在應用程式伺服器回應中完整保留結構化的 MCP 工具與資源錯誤
title.en: Preserve structured MCP tool and resource errors in app-server responses

body.zh-TW: ⟦好比檢驗所回傳健康檢查報告時，完整保留了各項數值的代碼、異常指標與備註欄位，而非只丟出一張模糊的檢查失敗單據。⟧當外部服務呼叫失敗時，應用程式伺服器現在能為前端提供完整詳細的錯誤資訊。在與 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器溝通時，若工具執行或資源讀取發生例外，app-server 的回應會完整保留結構化的錯誤代碼與詳細欄位。這避免了將錯誤壓平成字串而遺失細節，讓開發者能精確定位問題發生的根源。
body.en: ⟦It is like a medical lab report retaining specific diagnostic codes and reference ranges instead of printing a generic test failure message.⟧ When external services encounter issues, app-server responses now preserve structured MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool and resource errors. Rather than flattening error responses into plain text strings, the system keeps structured fields intact so client applications and developers can programmatically handle failures and identify root causes.

items.original: Preserved structured MCP tool and resource errors in app-server responses. (#41196)

title.zh-TW: 將巢狀子代理的 Token 用量納入根目標的總額度計算
title.en: Count nested subagent token usage toward root goal budgets

body.zh-TW: 指派多層任務讓 AI 自行拆解執行時，運算資源的控管變得更加嚴密。當主要任務委派多層巢狀子代理（subagent，分派任務的次級助手）協同作業時，其資源消耗有了統籌計算。所有子代理消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量，現在都會全數計入根目標的總預算中。這防止了底層子代理消耗過多運算資源而超出整體預算的狀況。⟦這像總承包商進行工程預算管控，底下各包商與下包工班的所有開銷，都必須逐筆即時記在總工程款帳目上一併核銷。⟧
body.en: Budget tracking across multi-agent workflows is now strictly enforced. When a primary task delegates work to nested subagents across multiple tiers, token consumption from every child agent is counted toward the root goal budget. This prevents deep subagent branches from silently exceeding the project token allocation. ⟦It is like a general contractor accounting for every subcontractor and specialist on a project, ensuring all labor hours bill against the master construction budget.⟧

items.original: Counted nested subagent token usage toward root goal budgets. (#41183)

title.zh-TW: 防止權限狀態變更後因過期的 Guardian 分類結果而誤予授權
title.en: Prevent stale Guardian classifications from authorizing actions after permission changes

body.zh-TW: 調整防護等級時，系統的安全閘門能即時反映最新狀態。Guardian（負責審查指令安全性並進行風險分類的防護機制）過去留存的判定結果，在使用者更改權限設定後不再被沿用。系統現在會在權限狀態變更時立即將舊判定標記為失效，嚴格防止過期（stale，不再適用於當前狀態的舊資料）分類資料在新的權限規則下誤放行危險操作。這確保了每一次安全決策都符合當前的防護規則。⟦好比銀行調降信用卡安全額度時，系統同步註銷先前簽發但尚未請款的預先授權碼，防止持卡人在新規生效後被舊核准扣款。⟧
body.en: Security enforcement now reacts instantly whenever authorization rules change. Previously cached classifications from Guardian (the security component that categorizes action risks) are no longer used after permission states change. The system invalidates stale classification data immediately upon permission updates, ensuring that outdated approvals cannot authorize new actions after permission state changes. ⟦It is like a bank revoking outstanding pre-authorization holds the moment a credit limit is lowered, preventing old approvals from charging against the updated cap.⟧

items.original: Prevented stale Guardian classifications from authorizing actions after permission state changes. (#41196)

title.zh-TW: 為升級的標準輸入審查與遠端執行器 MCP 探索新增遙測日誌
title.en: Add telemetry for escalated stdin reviews and remote executor MCP discovery

body.zh-TW: ⟦像維運記錄器分別記下需要升級審查的標準輸入事件，以及遠端執行器探索 MCP 伺服器的事件。⟧系統運作監控與除錯分析的涵蓋範圍在本次更新中獲得擴充。當 stdin（標準輸入，程式接收打字或指令輸入的管道）審查需要升級時，系統會自動記錄相關事件。在遠端執行器探索 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，也會發送對應的遙測數據。這協助維護者深入掌握安全審查與遠端工具連接的執行狀況。
body.en: ⟦a maintenance recorder separately logging escalated stdin review events and MCP discovery events from remote executors.⟧ Observability into security reviews and remote connections is now expanded. Codex introduces dedicated telemetry tracking for escalated stdin reviews whenever interactive input requires elevated approval. It also logs remote executor MCP (Model Context Protocol) discovery events, giving maintainers clearer visibility into tool registration flows.

items.original: Added telemetry for escalated stdin reviews and remote executor MCP discovery. (#41189, #41205)

title.zh-TW: 提升慢速與高併發持續整合環境下 Guardian WebSocket 與核心測試的穩定度
title.en: Stabilize Guardian WebSocket and core fixture tests in slow or concurrent CI

body.zh-TW: Guardian WebSocket 與核心 fixture 測試在網路延遲或高負載下較不會假性失敗，也能穩定通過。系統全面加固了 Guardian（安全審查守護模組）的通訊機制，使其 WebSocket 雙向連線更加可靠。核心 fixture（測試治具，提供測試環境與初始資料的輔助套件）測試也進行了相應的穩定化調整。⟦這如同在風雨交加或多車同時通行的跨海大橋上加裝減震結構，確保橋梁在惡劣氣候與尖峰車流下依然平穩暢通。⟧
body.en: Guardian WebSocket connections and core fixture tests now run reliably under high load or network latency. Guardian WebSocket connections and core test fixtures have been hardened against timing issues. Even when test suites run on slow CI (continuous integration) runners or under heavy concurrency, core fixture tests complete predictably without false alarms. ⟦It is like reinforcing a suspension bridge with dampers so that it stays completely stable through severe storms and rush hour traffic.⟧

items.original: Stabilized Guardian WebSocket and core fixture tests under slow or highly concurrent CI. (#41191, #41194)

entries: Remote compaction now counts retained images toward its token budget by default, trimming older images as needed. (#41003)

title.zh-TW: 遠端壓縮納入保留的圖片算額度，舊圖依需求自動削減
title.en: Remote compaction counts retained images toward token budgets and reduces older ones as needed

body.zh-TW: 在長篇對話裡傳送多張截圖，⟦就像在一本厚度有限的專案剪貼簿裡貼滿照片與說明，一旦紙張有限，厚重的相片往往最容易佔滿整本手冊的配額。⟧現在 Codex 在背景執行遠端壓縮（remote compaction，在伺服器端壓縮長對話紀錄的機制）時，預設會把保留的圖片也一併算進可用配額。這項機制會把保留的圖片計入 token（AI 處理與計量的文字單位）預算，並在需要時自動削減較早傳入的舊圖片。如此一來，長篇對話就不會因為累積過多歷史圖片而悄悄撐破長度上限，同時也能確保最新的畫面資訊持續被妥善保留。
body.en: Sending multiple screenshots in a long conversation ⟦is like pasting photos and notes into a project scrapbook of limited thickness, where bulky pictures easily eat up the binder's allowance.⟧ When Codex runs remote compaction to compress lengthy conversation histories on the server, it now counts retained images toward its token budget by default. The mechanism reduces older images as needed to keep things lean. This ensures that long discussions stay safely within context limits without silently overflowing due to accumulated image history, while preserving your most recent visual references.

items.original: Remote compaction now counts retained images toward its token budget by default, trimming older images as needed. (#41003)

title.zh-TW: 支援 @ 引用其他任務，並可透過終端機由代理收發與建立任務
title.en: Reference tasks with @ mentions and manage tasks via terminal agents

body.zh-TW: 在終端機同時推進多項任務時，跨任務調度現在變得像通訊軟體一樣自然。⟦宛如在專案群組裡直接 `@` 任務看板，助理就能立刻去翻閱別組進度、建立新工單或遞送留言。⟧你可以用 `@` 標記其他 Codex 任務來直接引用其內容；也能在終端機中請代理（agent，自動替你執行任務的 AI 助手）讀取特定任務、建立新任務，或向進行中的任務傳送訊息。這讓多工協作時不必手動複製貼上歷史紀錄。
body.en: When running multiple parallel tasks in the terminal, coordinating across workflows is now as natural as using team chat. ⟦It is like @-mentioning a project ticket in a group channel so an assistant can immediately inspect another team's progress, open a new task, or drop a memo.⟧ You can now use `@` mentions to reference other Codex tasks directly in your prompt. You can also ask agents from the terminal to inspect existing tasks, spin up new ones, or dispatch messages to active tasks without manual copy-pasting.

items.original: Reference other Codex tasks with `@` mentions, and ask agents to read, create, or message tasks from the terminal. (#40308, #40315)

title.zh-TW: /copy 新增互動選單，可自選複製全文、獨立程式碼或引用區塊
title.en: /copy introduces an interactive picker for responses, code blocks, and quotes

body.zh-TW: 想從長篇對話中抽出一小段程式碼或重點時，不用再拿滑鼠在終端機裡吃力選取。輸入 `/copy` 指令後，介面現在會跳出選擇清單。你可以自由挑選要複製整篇完整回覆、各個獨立的程式碼區塊，或是特定的引用區塊。這讓擷取內容變得更加精準俐落。⟦好比便當盒裡將主菜、配菜與白飯各自獨立分格，你可以只夾取需要的那一道菜，不必整盒倒出來挑選。⟧
body.en: When extracting a specific snippet or excerpt from a long reply, you no longer need to drag your mouse across terminal text. Running `/copy` now opens an interactive picker menu. You can explicitly choose between copying the full response, individual code blocks, or markdown blockquotes. ⟦It is like a bento box where main dishes, sides, and rice are neatly partitioned so you can pick out the exact portion you want without dumping the whole container.⟧

items.original: `/copy` now offers a picker for full responses, individual code blocks, and blockquotes. (#39997)

title.zh-TW: 未命名任務自動生成描述性標題，/rename 主動提供建議名稱
title.en: Unnamed tasks get automatic titles and /rename suggests conversation-based edits

body.zh-TW: 終端機裡開了一堆任務卻常分不清內容的問題，現在有了更省心的解法。⟦如同圖書管理員看一眼未命名卷宗的內文就自動貼上書脊標籤，你要改名時還會主動遞上鉛筆草稿供你修改。⟧未手動命名的終端機任務現在會根據對話自動獲得具描述性的標題；當你想重新命名時，輸入 `/rename` 指令也會依據當前對話主動建議一段可編輯的標題草稿。這讓你在任務清單中能一眼辨識目標，省去手動打字命名的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When juggling multiple background tasks in your terminal, identifying what each task is doing is now effortless. ⟦It is like a diligent librarian who glances at an unlabelled folder to affix a descriptive spine label, and offers a pencil draft when you ask to rename it.⟧ Unnamed terminal tasks now automatically receive descriptive titles based on context. Furthermore, running `/rename` inspects your conversation history and suggests an editable title proposal, saving you from having to type names manually.

items.original: Unnamed terminal tasks receive descriptive titles automatically, and `/rename` suggests an editable title based on the conversation. (#40492, #40495)

title.zh-TW: 終端機 Markdown 連結化身可點擊標籤，未支援環境完整保留網址
title.en: Clickable Markdown link labels in supported terminals with URLs preserved elsewhere

body.zh-TW: 閱讀包含超連結的回覆時，終端機畫面變得更加乾淨易讀。在支援超連結的終端機環境下，Markdown 格式的連結會直接顯示為可點擊的簡潔文字標籤；而在不支援點擊的其他終端機中，系統則會完整保留原本可見的網址字串。這樣既能保持排版清爽，又確保在任何環境下都不會遺失網址資訊。⟦正如互動螢幕上可直接點選關鍵字跳轉，而在紙本手冊上則完整印出網址，兼顧了便利與完整。⟧
body.en: Reviewing responses that contain hyperlinks is now much cleaner in your terminal. On supported terminals, Markdown links render as tidy, clickable text labels. In environments without hyperlink support, the full visible URLs remain intact so you can still read and copy them easily. ⟦It is like a modern touchscreen display where keywords are directly tap-friendly, while a printed guide still prints the full web address alongside them for completeness.⟧

items.original: Markdown links appear as clickable labels in supported terminals, with visible URLs retained elsewhere. (#40471)

title.zh-TW: 自訂快捷鍵可循環切換權限模式
title.en: Custom shortcuts cycle permission modes

body.zh-TW: 你可以把循環切換權限模式的動作綁定到快捷鍵。權限模式（permission mode，決定系統在執行動作時如何處理確認的規則）會隨著這個按鍵依序切換。⟦這像洗衣機的一顆模式旋鈕：每轉一下便換到下一種洗程；同一顆旋鈕只負責選洗程。⟧當工作需要換一種確認方式時，使用你設定的快捷鍵，即可在可用的權限模式間循環切換；想再換一種就繼續按下去。
body.en: You can bind cycling through permission modes to a custom shortcut. A permission mode determines how Codex handles confirmation before an action, and the bound key moves through the available modes in sequence. ⟦It is like the program dial on a washing machine: each turn advances to the next wash cycle, and that dial has only one job—choosing a cycle.⟧ When your work calls for a different confirmation approach, press the shortcut you configured to cycle to it.

items.original: Bind shortcuts to cycle permission modes, and use `.` in Vim mode to repeat your last edit. (#39873, #40521)

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式可用 `.` 重複上一個編輯
title.en: Vim mode uses `.` to repeat the last edit

body.zh-TW: Vim 模式裡有多處要做同樣的文字修改時，現在按下 `.` 就能重複上一個編輯。Vim 模式（以鍵盤指令操作文字的編輯方式）會把剛完成的編輯動作交給 `.` 重新執行，不必再次逐字輸入相同變更。⟦這像文書軟體的「重複上一個動作」按鈕：上一筆改字完成後，按它便再套用那筆修改；它不負責切換任何工作模式。⟧這是 Vim 模式中的編輯重複功能。
body.en: When the same text change is needed in several places in Vim mode, pressing `.` now repeats your last edit. Vim mode is a keyboard-command way to edit text; `.` reruns the edit you just completed, so you do not need to type that same change again. ⟦It is like a word processor's Repeat Last Action button: after one edit, pressing it applies that edit again, and it does not switch any work mode.⟧ This is the editing-repeat feature for Vim mode.

items.original: Bind shortcuts to cycle permission modes, and use `.` in Vim mode to repeat your last edit. (#39873, #40521)

title.zh-TW: 新增 Interrupt 掛鉤，在頂層對話中斷時執行指令或 MCP 處理常式
title.en: New Interrupt hooks trigger commands or MCP handlers on cancelled turns

body.zh-TW: 任務執行途中突然按暫停時，後續的清理與自訂動作現在能自動接手。⟦宛如工廠產線上的緊急停止按鈕，一拍下就會連帶觸發排氣閥與自動斷電程序，確保現場收拾乾淨。⟧系統新增了 `Interrupt` hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）。當進行中的頂層對話輪次被中斷時，這項機制可以自動執行命令列指令，或呼叫 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）處理常式進行收尾。這讓中止操作不再只是粗暴中斷，而能妥善保存狀態或釋放佔用的資源。
body.en: When cancelling an active turn midway, automated cleanup and custom actions can now take over immediately. ⟦It is like an emergency stop switch on an assembly line that instantly triggers exhaust vents and safe power-down sequences to keep the floor clean.⟧ Codex introduces `Interrupt` hooks. When an active top-level conversation turn is interrupted, these hooks can automatically run shell commands or trigger MCP handlers, allowing your environment to safely persist state or release held resources instead of abruptly terminating.

items.original: New `Interrupt` hooks can run commands or MCP handlers when an active top-level turn is interrupted. (#40511)

title.zh-TW: 未受信任專案禁止載入 AGENTS.md，權限變更後持續強制拒絕讀取規則
title.en: Block untrusted project AGENTS.md and preserve managed deny-read rules

body.zh-TW: 開啟來源不明的專案時，系統築起了更嚴密的安全防線。未受信任的專案不再能隨意提供專案層級的 `AGENTS.md` 指示檔，防止惡意專案藉由預先埋設的指令操控 AI 行為。此外，由管理政策所設定的拒絕讀取規則，在使用者中途變更權限後依然會強制生效，不會被意外覆蓋或失效。這確保了敏感檔案在整個操作過程中始終受到保護。⟦正如訪客不能自帶自訂的進出規約交給警衛，且就算換發了臨時通行證，嚴禁閱覽機密檔案的禁令依然牢不可破。⟧
body.en: Opening repositories from unknown sources is now significantly safer. Untrusted projects are no longer allowed to supply project-level `AGENTS.md` instruction files, preventing malicious repositories from hijacking AI behavior with embedded prompts. Additionally, managed deny-read security rules remain strictly enforced even after interactive permission changes occur during a session. ⟦It is like a visitor who cannot bring their own house rules to security, and even after receiving a temporary pass, confidential archive access remains firmly locked.⟧

items.original: Untrusted projects no longer supply project-level `AGENTS.md` instructions, and managed deny-read rules remain enforced after permission changes. (#39837, #40004)

title.zh-TW: 強化診斷日誌敏感資料遮蔽，自動隱藏提供者、權杖更新與認證欄位
title.en: Enhanced credential redaction for provider, refresh, and attestation diagnostics

body.zh-TW: 匯出診斷日誌排除故障時，機密資訊的外洩風險現在降得更低。系統強化了應用程式伺服器診斷報告中的 credential（登入憑證，證明身分與權限的密鑰資料）遮蔽處理。這次改進精確涵蓋了服務提供者、身分驗證更新以及 attestation（證明裝置與環境合法性的認證欄位）等關鍵資料。當你分享除錯診斷資訊時，這些敏感欄位會被自動遮蓋。⟦恰如對外提供財務報表時，系統自動用黑筆塗掉身分證字號、刷新授權碼與防偽認證碼，確保隱私滴水不漏。⟧
body.en: Exporting diagnostic reports for troubleshooting is now much safer. Codex has expanded credential redaction across app-server diagnostics. Sensitive data is now automatically masked across provider details, authentication refresh flows, and hardware attestation fields. When you share debug output with maintainers, secret tokens and verification payloads will never leak into log files. ⟦It is like preparing an audited statement where an automated marker blacks out personal IDs, refresh codes, and security stamp certificates before export.⟧

items.original: Improved credential redaction in app-server diagnostics, including provider, authentication refresh, and attestation fields. (#39993)

title.zh-TW: 修復遠端 MCP 權杖查詢與必備伺服器啟動，並維持舊版相容性
title.en: Fix remote MCP bearer token lookup and startup while keeping executor compatibility

body.zh-TW: 連接遠端擴充工具時，驗證與啟動流程現在更加穩定順暢。⟦好比連鎖店更新了專用通訊網路，既能精準辨識通行權杖並順利喚醒必備主機，同時依然相容舊款收銀終端機。⟧系統修復了遠端 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具的連線問題。程式在查詢遠端 bearer token（驗證存取權限的授權令牌）時不再出錯，也修正了必要伺服器的啟動邏輯。整套調整完整維持了與舊版執行器的相容性，不必擔心升級後舊環境無法運作。
body.en: Connecting to remote tool extensions is now much more dependable. ⟦It is like a retail network upgrading its authentication lines to reliably verify access tokens and boot core servers, while remaining fully backwards-compatible with older register hardware.⟧ Codex has resolved issues with remote MCP server connections. The system now reliably looks up bearer tokens and initializes required servers without failure, all while maintaining full backwards compatibility with older executor environments.

items.original: Fixed remote MCP bearer-token lookup and required-server startup while preserving compatibility with older executors. (#39926, #39952, #39979)

title.zh-TW: 修復 Windows 高權限沙盒建立失敗，支援 Unicode 使用者路徑啟動別名
title.en: Fix elevated Windows sandbox setup and launch aliases under Unicode paths

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上使用特殊使用者名稱或高權限執行時，環境建立不再卡住。以前當使用者的個人資料夾路徑包含非英文字元（Unicode 字元，如中文或特殊符號）時，啟動別名常會失效。此外，在建立 elevated 管理員高權限沙盒環境時也會遭遇設定錯誤。現在這些路徑與權限問題都已修復，確保在各類系統設定下都能順利啟動隔離環境。⟦就像印刷廠校正排版與裝機流程：標籤上有各種文字都能正確辨識，需要高規格設備的隔離作業區也能順利備妥。⟧
body.en: Running Codex on Windows with elevated permissions or special account names is now completely smooth. Previously, if a user profile folder contained non-ASCII Unicode characters (such as accents or non-Latin scripts), launch aliases would often fail. Elevated sandbox environments running with administrator privileges also encountered initialization errors. Both path handling and privilege escalation setups are now resolved. ⟦It is like a print shop tuning its typesetting and setup line: labels in different scripts are recognized correctly, and an isolated work bay needing high-spec equipment is prepared without a hitch.⟧

items.original: Fixed elevated Windows sandbox setup and launch aliases under Unicode user paths. (#39971, #40570)

title.zh-TW: 防止 Unix 結束時因已脫離的行程佔用終端機或緩衝區塞滿而卡死
title.en: Prevent Unix shutdown hangs caused by detached processes or full buffers

body.zh-TW: 在 Unix 系統（如 macOS 或 Linux 等環境）結束程式時，不再因為背景殘留問題而卡死。以前當已脫離的行程依然佔用終端機，或者輸出緩衝區已被塞滿時，結束程式的流程常會陷入無限等待；現在系統會妥善清理這些狀態並順利退出。這讓每次離開工具時都能乾脆俐落。⟦如同下班關閉辦公室總電源時，即便角落的碎紙機還插著電或出紙匣堆滿紙張，總開關也能順利切斷電源順暢關門。⟧
body.en: Exiting Codex on Unix systems like macOS or Linux is now fast and reliable. Previously, shutting down could hang indefinitely if detached background processes still held terminal handles or if output buffers were completely full. The shutdown sequence now cleans up detached processes and flushes full buffers properly. ⟦It is like locking up an office at the end of the day: even if a paper shredder in the corner is still plugged in or its output tray is full, the master switch reliably cuts power and lets you lock the doors.⟧

items.original: Prevented Unix shutdown hangs caused by detached processes retaining a terminal or full terminal output buffers. (#40460)

title.zh-TW: 修復 Amazon Bedrock 模型的對話壓縮錯誤與多代理協同相容性
title.en: Fix Amazon Bedrock conversation compaction and multi-agent compatibility

body.zh-TW: 透過雲端服務租用模型時，長對話與多任務協作變得更穩定。⟦宛如跨國視訊會議的雲端秘書團隊，既能順利把冗長發言濃縮成精華摘要，多位專職助理在同一條線上協同分工時也不再斷線衝突。⟧針對使用 Amazon Bedrock（亞馬遜雲端託管的 AI 模型平台）的使用者，系統修復了長對話的歷史壓縮錯誤；同時也解決了多代理協同作業時的相容性問題。這讓透過雲端模型處理複雜專案時更加流暢。
body.en: Running long conversations and multi-agent setups through cloud platforms is now much more reliable. ⟦It is like a remote conference team where an assistant cleanly summarizes lengthy meeting records while specialized specialists collaborate on the same call without stepping on each other.⟧ For developers using Amazon Bedrock models, Codex has fixed errors during conversation compaction when compressing long context windows. Multi-agent compatibility issues have also been resolved, allowing multiple sub-agents to collaborate smoothly.

items.original: Fixed conversation compaction and multi-agent compatibility for Amazon Bedrock models. (#39804, #39825)

entries: Added an interactive `codex agents` dashboard for searching, starting, opening, renaming, and stopping tasks, with configurable shortcuts. (#39094, #39112, #39114, #39142)
Added `/cd`, `/pwd`, and `/cwd` commands for managing the working directory in TUI sessions. (#38894)
Added `codex queue` for sending messages to existing local or remote sessions. (#39092)

SDK users can now pass exact CLI config overrides and select `max` or `ultra` reasoning effort. (#38817, #39662)
Queued messages now wake idle sessions reliably, resolve duplicate session names more usefully, and preserve pasted or deferred command semantics. (#39034, #39385, #39604)
Resumed and forked threads now restore their active permission profile instead of silently falling back to current defaults. (#39153)
Fixed duplicate sub-agent activity and tightened TUI routing for sub-agent notifications and approvals. (#39049, #39088)
Realtime WebRTC sideband connections now reconnect after unexpected transport loss without dropping pending output. (#39257)
Inline TUI history now remains available in Windows Terminal scrollback. (#39619)
Inactive TUI thread replay buffers are now bounded to prevent excessive retained streamed output. (#39081)
Clarified that external contributions should go through issues and design discussion rather than pull requests. (#39089)
Documented DNS exfiltration risks and trust limitations for secure devcontainers. (#39283)

title.zh-TW: 新增 agents 互動儀表板，集中管理各項任務
title.en: Interactive agents dashboard for managing background tasks

body.zh-TW: 同時交辦多個 AI 任務時，現在不用在終端機裡盲目切換。⟦宛如車間牆上的即時派工白板，所有工單一目了然，隨手按個按鍵就能迅速調度。⟧在命令列輸入 `codex agents` 即可開啟互動式 dashboard（集中查看與操作所有任務的控制面板）。你能在這個畫面中搜尋、啟動、開啟、重新命名以及停止各項任務。如果習慣特定的鍵盤操作，介面也支援自訂快速鍵，讓你用最順手的方式管理所有背景工作。
body.en: When juggling multiple AI tasks, you no longer have to switch blindly across terminal windows. ⟦It is like a dispatch whiteboard on a workshop wall, keeping every job ticket in plain view and ready for quick key commands.⟧ Run `codex agents` in your terminal to open an interactive dashboard. Inside this view, you can search, start, open, rename, and stop tasks. The interface also provides configurable shortcuts so you can navigate and manage all your background jobs using your preferred keystrokes.

items.original: Added an interactive `codex agents` dashboard for searching, starting, opening, renaming, and stopping tasks, with configurable shortcuts. (#39094, #39112, #39114, #39142)

title.zh-TW: 新增 /cd、/pwd 與 /cwd 指令，在工作階段內切換目錄
title.en: Manage working directories in TUI sessions with /cd, /pwd, and /cwd

body.zh-TW: 在終端機與 Codex 對話時，如果想換到另一個資料夾處理程式碼，現在不必關掉重開。在 TUI（以文字排版的終端機互動介面）的工作階段中，你可以直接輸入 `/cd` 切換工作目錄，或者用 `/pwd` 與 `/cwd` 印出當前所在的路徑。這讓你在同一次交談裡隨時移動工作位置，省去退出對話再重新連線的麻煩。⟦彷彿在圖書館自習時直接抱著課本換到隔壁桌，不必收拾書包重新刷卡入館。⟧
body.en: When talking with Codex in the terminal, you no longer need to exit and restart just to switch folders. Inside a TUI (text-based user interface) session, you can now enter `/cd` to change your working directory, or run `/pwd` and `/cwd` to print your current location. This allows you to navigate across different project folders within the same conversation without losing your ongoing thread. ⟦It is like moving to a neighboring study desk in a library without packing your backpack and checking in again.⟧

items.original: Added `/cd`, `/pwd`, and `/cwd` commands for managing the working directory in TUI sessions. (#38894)

title.zh-TW: 新增 codex queue 指令，將訊息排入指定工作階段
title.en: Send messages to local and remote sessions with codex queue

body.zh-TW: 另開終端機想傳話給正在跑的任務時，`codex queue` 提供了直接插話的管道。⟦正如往同事桌上的待辦匣投遞便條，就算對方正在休息也會被輕拍喚醒，遇上同名同事也能精準投遞。⟧這個新指令可將訊息送進本機或遠端既有的工作階段（保存對話與狀態的執行單元）。排入佇列的訊息現在能確實喚醒閒置中的工作階段；碰上重複的工作階段名稱時，系統能更聰明地辨識目標；同時完整保留貼上文字或延遲執行指令的原有語意，確保工作不失真。
body.en: When you need to send instructions from another window to an existing task, `codex queue` offers a direct channel. ⟦It is like dropping a note into a colleague's inbox tray: it gently wakes them if they are resting and routes accurately even when coworkers share a name.⟧ This new command delivers messages to existing local or remote sessions. Queued messages now reliably wake idle sessions, resolve duplicate session names more intelligently, and preserve the original semantics of pasted or deferred commands without corruption.

items.original:
Added `codex queue` for sending messages to existing local or remote sessions. (#39092)
Queued messages now wake idle sessions reliably, resolve duplicate session names more usefully, and preserve pasted or deferred command semantics. (#39034, #39385, #39604)

title.zh-TW: 擴充 Vim 編輯模式，支援單字換寫與字元替換
title.en: Expanded Vim editing motions and character replacement

body.zh-TW: 習慣在終端機用 Vim 模式打字的人，編輯提示詞的手感現在更加完整。系統擴充了字元替換功能，也加入多個常用的變更動作。例如你可以用 `cw` 換掉當前單字，用 `c$` 改寫游標到行尾的文字，或者按 `cc` 清空整行重新輸入。這些快捷動作讓修改輸入內容時更加順手，不必依賴退格鍵逐字倒退。⟦如同雕刻師換上專用雕刀，削掉局部字詞或改動單一筆劃時不必整塊木料重磨。⟧
body.en: For developers accustomed to Vim bindings in the terminal, editing prompts is now much smoother. Codex has expanded Vim editing with single-character replacement and additional change motions. You can now use `cw` to change a word, `c$` to change to the end of the line, or `cc` to rewrite the entire current line. These key combinations let you reshape text in place without backspacing character by character. ⟦It is like a woodcarver switching to specialized chisels, trimming a word or reshaping a line without sanding down the entire block.⟧

items.original: Expanded Vim editing with character replacement and more change motions such as `cw`, `c$`, and `cc`. (#39661)

title.zh-TW: codex doctor 擴大診斷，全面檢查防護與連線狀態
title.en: codex doctor diagnoses endpoint protection and network failures

body.zh-TW: 遇到連線異常或環境卡住時，診斷工具能幫你更快找出病灶。⟦如同診所健檢新增了免疫防禦與血液循環檢查，一次把潛在隱患排查清楚。⟧執行 `codex doctor` 指令時，檢查範圍現在涵蓋四大關鍵項目：端點防護軟體的阻擋、網路與 proxy（代理伺服器，替你轉發網路請求的中介主機）連線故障、桌面應用程式的運作狀態，以及版本更新伺服器的連線能力。當工具無法正常工作時，你能第一時間釐清是公司安全軟體攔截還是網路設定出錯。
body.en: When troubleshooting connection hiccups or frozen environments, the built-in diagnostic tool can pinpoint issues faster. ⟦It is like a clinic checkup adding immune defense and circulation scans to identify hidden trouble spots in one visit.⟧ Running `codex doctor` now inspects four critical areas: endpoint protection software interference, network and proxy failures, desktop application state, and update server connectivity. When something breaks, you can immediately tell whether corporate security software or network routing is at fault.

items.original: `codex doctor` now diagnoses endpoint protection, network/proxy failures, desktop app state, and update connectivity. (#38827, #38918, #39060, #39074)

title.zh-TW: SDK 支援精確設定覆寫，並加入 max 與 ultra 推理選項
title.en: SDK config overrides and max or ultra reasoning effort

body.zh-TW: 透過 SDK（軟體開發套件，讓程式碼直接叫用工具功能的套件庫）呼叫 Codex 的開發者，現在擁有更細緻的控制權。你可以在程式碼中直接傳入精確的 CLI 設定覆寫值，依照當前任務需求微調各項參數。此外，針對需要深度思考的複雜問題，推理力度的選項新加入了 `max` 與 `ultra` 兩檔設定，讓模型投入最充足的推理資源來解析難題。⟦宛如賽車手既能精細調校底盤參數，又能在面臨險峻賽道時切換至極限增壓檔位。⟧
body.en: Developers calling Codex through an SDK (Software Development Kit) now enjoy much tighter control over execution. You can directly pass exact CLI configuration overrides from your code to fine-tune settings for specific tasks. In addition, when tackling complex logic that requires deep deliberation, you can set the reasoning effort to `max` or `ultra` to dedicate maximum reasoning capacity to the problem. ⟦It is like a racing driver precisely tuning chassis parameters while having access to an ultra-boost gear for challenging terrain.⟧

items.original: SDK users can now pass exact CLI config overrides and select `max` or `ultra` reasoning effort. (#38817, #39662)

title.zh-TW: 接續與分岔對話時，完整還原既有的權限設定檔
title.en: Resumed and forked threads restore their permission profiles

body.zh-TW: 接續先前暫停的對話，或從中分岔出新分支時，原本配置的權限規則現在會完整保留。⟦恰如重開暫停的專案時自動配發原本的專屬通行證，不會默默退回一般訪客的備援設定。⟧系統在接續或分岔對話串時，會確實還原當時啟用的 permission profile（權限設定檔）。程式不會再不聲不響退回當前預設值。這確保你在特定安全等級下進行的任務，重開後仍維持相同的授權邊界。
body.en: When picking up a paused conversation or forking a new branch from it, your configured permission rules are now fully preserved. ⟦It is like reopening a paused project and receiving your designated access badge rather than getting demoted to a generic guest pass.⟧ Resuming or forking a thread now restores its active permission profile instead of silently falling back to the current system defaults. This ensures that tasks configured with specific security guardrails retain the exact same authorization boundaries when resumed.

items.original: Resumed and forked threads now restore their active permission profile instead of silently falling back to current defaults. (#39153)

title.zh-TW: 修正子代理重複動作，釐清通知與審核傳遞路徑
title.en: Fix duplicate sub-agent actions and tighten approval routing

body.zh-TW: 讓主代理呼叫子代理分頭做事時，背後的通訊與排程變得更加乾淨。以前子代理有時會不小心重複執行同一個動作，通知訊息與授權核准也可能在介面中傳遞混亂；現在這些問題都已修正。TUI 精準收緊了子代理通知與審核確認的傳遞路徑，確保每個需要你同意的動作都能正確呈現在畫面上。⟦如同機場塔台把每架飛機的到場通知與起飛許可導向正確頻道，也不會對同一架飛機重複下達起飛指令。⟧
body.en: When a primary agent delegates work to sub-agents, communication and scheduling are now significantly cleaner. Sub-agents previously could trigger duplicate activities, while notifications and approval requests sometimes took confusing paths through the interface. Codex has now resolved the duplicate actions and tightened TUI routing for sub-agent alerts and approvals. ⟦It is like an airport control tower sending each arrival alert and takeoff-clearance request down the right radio channel, without issuing the same aircraft a takeoff order twice.⟧

items.original: Fixed duplicate sub-agent activity and tightened TUI routing for sub-agent notifications and approvals. (#39049, #39088)

title.zh-TW: WebRTC 即時連線中斷後自動重連，不遺漏待送輸出
title.en: WebRTC sideband reconnects without dropping pending output

body.zh-TW: 透過即時通道接收輸出時，短暫的網路波動不再造成內容遺失。⟦彷彿步話機穿越隧道時計程短暫斷訊，連線接回後會把中斷期間的語音完整補齊而不漏字。⟧負責即時傳輸的 WebRTC（讓瀏覽器與應用程式直接進行影音或資料串流的通訊協定）側邊頻道連線，在遭遇非預期的傳輸中斷時，現在會自動嘗試重新連線。重新連上之後，中斷期間積壓、尚未送出的輸出資料會完整補送，不會被無故丟棄，確保傳輸過程不漏接任何字句。
body.en: When receiving output over real-time channels, brief network hiccups will no longer cause missing data. ⟦It is like a walkie-talkie passing through a tunnel: once signal returns, it plays back buffered speech without clipping a single word.⟧ Realtime WebRTC sideband connections now automatically reconnect after an unexpected transport loss. Once reconnected, pending output generated during the interruption is preserved and delivered rather than dropped, ensuring you never miss streamed responses.

items.original: Realtime WebRTC sideband connections now reconnect after unexpected transport loss without dropping pending output. (#39257)

title.zh-TW: Windows Terminal 完整保留行內 TUI 歷史紀錄
title.en: Windows Terminal scrollback retains inline TUI history

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows Terminal（微軟推出的現代化命令列終端機）中使用 Codex 的人，回頭翻閱過去的討論紀錄變得更加方便。以前在行內 TUI 模式下互動時，對話內容往往無法留在終端機自帶的 scrollback（向上捲動查看歷史輸出的緩衝區）裡；現在這些行內歷程會完整保留。你可以隨時用滑鼠滾輪往上滑，查看先前的程式碼與回應。⟦像把寫滿筆記的長卷往上捲動，先前的紀錄依然整齊保留在紙頁上方。⟧
body.en: For developers running Codex inside Windows Terminal, reviewing past discussions is now completely effortless. Previously in inline TUI mode, conversation output was not properly retained in the terminal's native scrollback buffer. Inline TUI history now remains available in Windows Terminal scrollback, allowing you to scroll up anytime to inspect previous code snippets and explanations. ⟦It is like unrolling a long notebook scroll where earlier meeting notes remain cleanly preserved at the top.⟧

items.original: Inline TUI history now remains available in Windows Terminal scrollback. (#39619)

title.zh-TW: 設定閒置對話重播上限，防止串流文字佔用記憶體
title.en: Bounded replay buffers for inactive threads prevent memory bloat

body.zh-TW: 背景掛著多個任務時，系統不再因為保留太多舊輸出而吃掉記憶體。⟦好似把封存箱設定容量上限，避免暫停工作的舊錄音檔無休止佔滿倉庫空間。⟧針對目前未處於活躍狀態的 TUI 對話串，其 replay buffer（用來重播串流過程的快取緩衝區）現在被設下了明確的儲存上限。這項限制能防止背景對話過度保留落落長的文字串流，大幅減輕記憶體負擔，讓長時間開著多個工作階段的操作更加輕盈穩定。
body.en: When keeping multiple background tasks open, Codex will no longer consume excessive memory by hoarding old streamed text. ⟦It is like setting a strict size limit on storage boxes so paused recordings do not overflow the warehouse.⟧ Replay buffers for inactive TUI threads are now strictly bounded. This restriction prevents inactive sessions from retaining massive amounts of streamed output in memory, reducing system resource usage and keeping long-running sessions lightweight and stable.

items.original: Inactive TUI thread replay buffers are now bounded to prevent excessive retained streamed output. (#39081)

title.zh-TW: 明確外部貢獻規範，先透過 issue 與設計討論凝聚共識
title.en: External contributions prioritized through issues and design discussions

body.zh-TW: 有意為 Codex 開源專案貢獻程式碼的開發者，現在有了更清晰的協作指引。官方在貢獻規範中明確指出，外部開發者的提案應先透過 GitHub issue 提出並進行架構設計討論，取得共識後再著手實作，而非直接送出 pull request（請求專案管理者合併程式碼的申請）。在動手寫程式前先對齊設計，可避免白費力氣。⟦正像裝修房屋時先與設計師確認藍圖並達成共識，再動工拉管線與砌牆。⟧
body.en: For developers looking to contribute to Codex, the contribution guidelines are now clearer. The documentation clarifies that external contributions should begin with an issue and architectural design discussion rather than jumping straight to a pull request. Aligning on the design before writing code helps avoid wasted effort. ⟦It is like reviewing blueprints with an architect to agree on room layouts before ordering bricks and knocking down walls.⟧

items.original: Clarified that external contributions should go through issues and design discussion rather than pull requests. (#39089)

title.zh-TW: 補充容器安全文件，揭示 DNS 資料外洩風險與信任極限
title.en: Documentation on DNS exfiltration risks and devcontainer trust limits

body.zh-TW: 在安全容器內執行未受信任的程式碼時，現在有更詳盡的防護風險指引。官方文件深入記錄了 secure devcontainer（用來隔離環境的開發容器）的信任限制。內容特別點出了 DNS 資料外洩的潛在威脅，說明惡意程式可能利用網域名稱查詢將機密資料外洩。這份說明提醒團隊在隔離環境中仍需嚴格審視網路外連政策。⟦好比在隔音嚴密的會議室辦公，若允許隨意對外寄信，信封上的地址查詢仍可能洩漏機密。⟧
body.en: When running untrusted code inside secure containers, developers now have clearer guidance on potential security boundaries. The documentation now details the trust limitations of secure devcontainers (isolated containerized development environments). It specifically highlights DNS exfiltration risks, explaining how malicious code could leak sensitive data via domain lookup requests. This guidance reminds teams to audit outbound network policies even within containerized setups. ⟦It is like working in a soundproof room: if anyone can mail letters outside, the address written on the envelope can still leak secrets.⟧

items.original: Documented DNS exfiltration risks and trust limitations for secure devcontainers. (#39283)

title.zh-TW: 整段終端對話可匯出成 Markdown
title.en: Export full terminal conversations to Markdown

body.zh-TW: 想把終端機裡和 Codex 討論過的內容交給同事，現在不用再逐段反白複製。⟦這像把散落在桌上的便條紙收進同一本筆記本。⟧在 TUI（文字介面的操作畫面）輸入 `/export`。完整對話會轉成 Markdown（用符號排出標題、清單等格式的純文字）。你可把結果放進剪貼簿，直接貼到別處；也可另存成新檔案。原本一段段散在畫面裡的提問、回覆和程式碼，會有可保存、可轉交的版本。
body.en: Need to hand a Codex conversation to a teammate? You no longer have to select and copy it piece by piece. ⟦It is like gathering loose notes from a desk into one notebook.⟧ Type `/export` in the TUI, the text-based interface, to turn the complete conversation into Markdown. Put it on the clipboard for pasting elsewhere, or save it as a new file. Questions, replies, and code that were spread across the screen now have a shareable copy.

items.original: Export complete TUI conversations to Markdown with `/export`, either to the clipboard or a new file. (#37358)

title.zh-TW: 工作階段可分岔，也能收起後找回
title.en: Fork, archive, and restore sessions

body.zh-TW: 同一個任務做到一半，想試另一條路又不想毀掉原本脈絡時，可以用 `codex exec fork` 分出一個工作階段（一次連續工作的上下文紀錄）。⟦這像從小說讀到岔路時，先夾好書籤，再翻到另一條支線。⟧原本的工作階段會留下來，新分支可另行探索。暫時不需要的紀錄也能在 TUI 的 resume picker（挑選要接續哪段工作的清單）歸檔；之後可從同一處還原，再繼續接手。
body.en: Halfway through a task, you may want to try another path without losing the original thread. Run `codex exec fork` to split off a session, the record of one continuous piece of work. ⟦It is like placing a bookmark at a fork in a novel before following another branch.⟧ The original session remains available while you explore the new one. You can also archive an inactive session from the TUI resume picker and restore it there later.

items.original: Fork sessions with `codex exec fork`, and archive or restore sessions from the TUI resume picker. (#37367, #37369, #37371)

title.zh-TW: 啟動尚未完成，也能先寫提示詞
title.en: Write prompts while TUI starts

body.zh-TW: 問題已經想好時，不必把鍵盤空著等 TUI 初始化完成；現在可先寫下提示詞（交給 AI 的工作要求），把問題先整理成可送出的要求。⟦像列車駛入月台時先填好行程單，乘車準備完成後便能立刻交出。⟧啟動畫面也會顯示接續工作階段與分岔工作的進度。於是你知道畫面仍在準備，還是正在替你恢復哪段工作或建立哪個分支，不會只面對毫無資訊的等待。
body.en: With the question already in mind, you no longer need to leave the keyboard idle while the TUI initializes: start drafting the prompt, the instruction for AI. ⟦It is like filling out a travel card while a train pulls into the platform, ready to hand over when boarding is prepared.⟧ Startup also shows progress for resuming and forking work. You can tell whether the screen is still preparing, restoring a session, or creating a branch instead of watching an unexplained wait.

items.original: Draft prompts while the TUI initializes, with resume and fork progress shown during startup. (#38642, #38788)

title.zh-TW: 可查看工作串的預估額度或費用
title.en: See estimated thread credits or cost

body.zh-TW: 在符合資格的工作區，想知道目前這串對話大約用了多少 credits（可用額度）或費用，現在不必離開終端機找帳務頁面。⟦這像計程車把預估車資同時顯示在儀表板、車頂燈和收據上。⟧輸入 `/status` 可查看估算，終端機最底下的狀態列與終端機標題也會顯示同類資訊。這是預估值，不是承諾的最終帳單；可用與否則取決於你的工作區是否符合資格。
body.en: In an eligible workspace, you can check an estimate of this thread's credits or cost without leaving the terminal for a billing page. ⟦It is like a taxi showing an estimated fare on its dashboard, roof light, and receipt.⟧ Run `/status` for the estimate; terminal status lines and titles can show it too. It remains an estimate rather than a final bill, and availability depends on workspace eligibility.

items.original: View estimated thread credits or cost in `/status`, status lines, and terminal titles for eligible workspaces. (#38281, #38282)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 可直接作為內建供應者
title.en: Use Amazon Bedrock as a built-in provider

body.zh-TW: 公司已用 AWS 的 Amazon Bedrock Runtime 跑 AI 時，Codex 現在把它列為內建 provider（提供模型連線的服務來源）。⟦像原本得外接的電器，現在插座已經裝在牆上。⟧它支援 AWS profile（AWS 的身分與連線設定）。也支援 region（服務所在區域）。GPT-5.6 的 routing 是把請求送往適合模型的規則，現在也支援。因此可依既有 AWS 身分、區域與路由來使用，而非另行接上一個外部提供者。
body.en: If your company already runs AI through Amazon Bedrock Runtime on AWS, Codex now includes it as a built-in provider, a source of model connections. ⟦It is like finding a wall socket already installed for an appliance that used to need an adapter.⟧ It supports AWS profiles and regions. It also supports routing for GPT-5.6. That lets it use your existing AWS identity, location, and routing choices rather than requiring another external provider connection.

items.original: Use Amazon Bedrock Runtime as a built-in provider with AWS profile, region, and GPT-5.6 routing support. (#38470)

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤可非同步跑指令，也能叫用 MCP
title.en: Hooks can run commands and MCP tools asynchronously

body.zh-TW: 要在特定事件發生時自動接一段處理，hooks（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在不必卡著等自己的指令跑完。它能非同步執行命令，也能叫用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具。⟦像舞台劇把換場交給後台，台上的演出不必等每件道具擺妥。⟧這讓掛鉤可在事件後啟動命令或外部工具，同時不把等待綁死在同一條執行流程上。
body.en: When an event should trigger an automatic follow-up, hooks, small programs triggered by specific events, no longer have to wait for their commands to finish. They can run commands asynchronously and invoke MCP tools, where MCP is a protocol that connects AI to external tools. ⟦It is like handing a scene change to backstage without making the performance wait for every prop to be set.⟧ A hook can start a command or external tool after an event without tying the same execution path to that wait.

items.original: Hooks can now run commands asynchronously and invoke MCP tools. (#37533, #38705)

title.zh-TW: 切換模型或設定，不再殘留舊指示
title.en: Model and settings changes no longer disrupt a turn

body.zh-TW: 一段工作正在進行時切換模型，或更新設定，以前可能留下舊指示，甚至改變進行中的 turn（一次送出要求到得到回應的處理回合）。現在這兩種變動不再造成那些結果。⟦正在煮湯時換一包調味料，不會讓鍋裡已經下過的材料忽然變成另一道菜。⟧你仍可調整模型和設定，但當前回合不會在中途被改寫，過時的指示也不應繼續留在後面，持續影響之後的工作流程。
body.en: Switching models or updating settings while work was in progress could leave old instructions behind or alter an active turn, one request-and-response processing round. That no longer happens. ⟦Changing a seasoning packet while soup cooks does not turn ingredients already in the pot into another dish.⟧ You can still change the model and settings, but the current turn is not rewritten midway and stale instructions should not remain in the background to keep affecting later work.

items.original: Model switches and settings updates no longer leave stale instructions behind or change an active turn midstream. (#37260, #38785)

title.zh-TW: 接回舊工作，目錄與核准規則會一併回來
title.en: Resumed sessions restore their workspace context

body.zh-TW: 隔一段時間再接回舊工作階段時，最怕從錯的資料夾開始，或發現先前的核准規則不見了。現在接續後會還原先前保存的 working directory（當時工作的資料夾）。approval policy（哪些動作需先徵得同意的規則）也會回來。逐字稿預覽也更準確。⟦像回到暫停的工作桌，桌牌、工具位置和進出規則都照原樣擺回來。⟧因此在 TUI 選擇接續時，較能辨認將要接手的內容與它原來工作的脈絡。
body.en: When returning to an earlier session, starting in the wrong folder or losing its approval rules is disruptive. Resumed sessions now restore the persisted working directory, the folder used for that work, and approval policy, the rules for actions that need consent. Transcript previews are also more accurate. ⟦It is like returning to a paused desk with its label, tools, and access rules put back in place.⟧ The TUI resume choice better shows what you are about to pick up and its original working context.

items.original: Resumed sessions now restore their persisted working directory and approval policy, with more accurate transcript previews. (#37198, #37368, #38605)

title.zh-TW: 供應者短暫斷線可重連，MCP 授權後也會恢復
title.en: Reconnect after provider outages and MCP reauthentication

body.zh-TW: 工作進行時 provider（提供模型服務的連線來源）暫時出問題，不再等同這一輪工作必須就此中斷。turn 會嘗試穿過暫時的供應者中斷重新連線。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器也會恢復。這發生在 OAuth（用既有帳號授權第三方服務的登入方式）重新驗證之後。⟦像電車短暫停電後接回電力，乘客不用先下車再從頭買票。⟧兩種恢復都不需重新啟動 Codex。
body.en: A temporary provider outage, where the source of model service connection has trouble, no longer means the current turn must end there. Turns reconnect through temporary provider outages. MCP servers, with MCP being the protocol connecting AI to external tools, also recover after OAuth reauthentication, where an existing account authorizes a third-party service. ⟦It is like a tram getting power back after a brief outage without asking passengers to leave and buy tickets again.⟧ Neither recovery requires restarting Codex.

items.original: Turns reconnect through temporary provider outages, and MCP servers recover after OAuth reauthentication without restarting Codex. (#37337, #37485, #38418)

title.zh-TW: 啟動時的殘留按鍵不會誤觸提示
title.en: Startup input no longer accidentally activates prompts

body.zh-TW: 看清 TUI（文字介面的操作畫面）之前，終端機先前暫存的按鍵輸入不會再突然啟用畫面上的提示或選項。這可避免某個 prompt（等待你輸入或選擇的詢問）在你讀到內容前就被誤觸。這項修正針對啟動時殘留的終端機輸入。⟦像早晨開啟音響時，昨天留下的遙控器訊號不會替你跳過今天想聽的第一首歌。⟧你能先確認眼前的詢問，再決定要輸入或選哪個選項。
body.en: Before you can read the TUI, the text-based interface, buffered terminal keystrokes no longer unexpectedly activate prompts or choices on screen. That prevents a prompt, a question waiting for input or selection, from being triggered before you can read it. ⟦It is like turning on a stereo in the morning without yesterday's remote signal skipping today's first song.⟧ You can inspect the question first, then decide what to enter or select.

items.original: TUI startup no longer lets buffered terminal input activate prompts accidentally, and onboarding appears when authentication is missing. (#38641, #38643, #38644)

title.zh-TW: 缺少驗證時，會顯示初次設定引導
title.en: Missing authentication shows onboarding

body.zh-TW: 登入驗證尚未備妥時，Codex 不會只停在缺少 authentication（證明你身分的登入驗證）的狀態。畫面會顯示 onboarding（第一次使用時帶你完成必要步驟的引導）。這是認證缺少時顯示的初次使用引導。它把缺少驗證的情況接到初次使用所需步驟，讓你看得見接下來該完成什麼。⟦像新手機尚未插入 SIM 卡時，螢幕先帶你完成連線設定，而不是只停在不能使用的畫面。⟧
body.en: If Codex lacks authentication, the login check that proves identity, it no longer leaves you only at that missing-authentication state. It shows onboarding, guidance through the steps needed for first use. This connects the missing check to the required first-use steps. ⟦It is like a new phone without a SIM card showing its connection setup instead of only an unusable screen.⟧

items.original: TUI startup no longer lets buffered terminal input activate prompts accidentally, and onboarding appears when authentication is missing. (#38641, #38643, #38644)

title.zh-TW: 貼上換行文字與長網址，編寫區不再排版錯亂
title.en: Composer and transcript formatting handle pasted text correctly

body.zh-TW: 把別處複製的文字貼進 composer（撰寫提示詞的輸入區）時，CRLF 是某些文字系統用兩個符號表示換行的格式。自動折行產生的空白和很長的 URL（網站位址）也都可能讓畫面看起來怪異。現在編寫區與 transcript（對話紀錄顯示區）會正確處理這些內容。⟦像把不同尺寸的紙張放進同一個資料夾，折痕與長標籤不會把頁面擠歪。⟧貼上含特殊換行、折行空白或長網址的內容時，文字應維持可讀的呈現。
body.en: Pasting text into the composer, the area for writing prompts, can bring CRLF, a two-symbol line-break format used by some text systems. Wrapped whitespace and long URLs, or web addresses, can also make the display render incorrectly. The composer and transcript, the conversation record display, now handle them correctly. ⟦It is like filing sheets of different sizes without letting folds and long labels bend the pages out of shape.⟧ Pasted special line breaks, wrapped spaces, and long URLs should now stay readable.

items.original: Composer and transcript rendering now handle CRLF pastes, wrapped whitespace, and long URLs correctly. (#37709, #38380, #38704)

title.zh-TW: 被拒或讀不到的路徑，沙盒會確實擋下
title.en: Sandbox denies restricted and unreadable paths

body.zh-TW: 沙盒是一種把程式可做的事圈在安全範圍內的隔離環境。遇到不允許或無法讀取的路徑時，現在採取 fail closed（無法確認安全時先拒絕）的做法。⟦像檔案封存室讀不清取件條碼時，先不交出文件，而不是猜測申請人有權領取。⟧這項限制涵蓋 Linux 和 Windows。換句話說，路徑被拒絕或不可讀時，沙盒不會繼續放行，而是以拒絕來保住限制的邊界。
body.en: A sandbox is an isolated environment that limits what a program can do. When it meets a denied or unreadable path, it now fails closed: it refuses access when safety cannot be confirmed. ⟦It is like an archive desk withholding a file when it cannot read the collection barcode, rather than guessing the requester may receive it.⟧ This restriction applies across Linux and Windows. A denied or unreadable path is not allowed through; the sandbox keeps the boundary by rejecting it.

items.original: Sandbox restrictions now fail closed for denied or unreadable paths across Linux and Windows. (#37875, #38026, #38416, #38660)

title.zh-TW: Skill-creator guide 更聚焦
title.en: Skill-creator guide is more focused

body.zh-TW: 替 Codex 建立 skill（讓它學會特定工作方法的操作指引）時，內附的 skill-creator guide 現在更聚焦。這份隨工具附上的說明集中於建立這類指引的工作，內容重點就是建立這類操作指引。⟦像登山地圖把前往山頂的路線集中標出，不把其他步道混在同一頁。⟧準備撰寫 skill 時，可參考這份更聚焦的 guide。
body.en: When you create a skill, an instruction guide that teaches Codex a particular way of working, its bundled skill-creator guide is now more focused. That guide concentrates on creating this kind of instruction. ⟦It is like a hiking map that marks the route to the summit together instead of mixing in other trails.⟧ Use the more focused guide when writing a skill.

items.original: The bundled skill-creator guide is more focused, and validation now rejects unfinished TODO placeholders. (#38384)

title.zh-TW: 未完成 TODO 會被驗證拒絕
title.en: Validation rejects unfinished TODO placeholders

body.zh-TW: 準備讓 skill 通過驗證時，未完成的 TODO（提醒日後補做的佔位文字）不能再留在內容裡。validation（檢查內容是否符合要求的程序）現在會拒絕這類佔位文字。這項拒絕針對仍未完成的 TODO 佔位文字。⟦像印刷前的校稿把「待補圖」標記退回，不把它當成已經完成的版面。⟧要通過驗證，skill 內容不能還留著這些未完成 TODO。
body.en: Before a skill can pass validation, unfinished TODO placeholders, text left to complete later, can no longer remain in its contents. Validation, the check that content meets requirements, now rejects those placeholders. ⟦It is like a proofreader returning a “figure pending” mark before printing rather than treating the page as finished.⟧ A skill that passes validation cannot keep unfinished TODO placeholders.

items.original: The bundled skill-creator guide is more focused, and validation now rejects unfinished TODO placeholders. (#38384)

title.en: Portable plugins with a safer fallback

body.zh-TW: 你換電腦或加入新工作區時，現在能安裝可攜式 Agent Plugins（代理外掛，替 Codex 加上工作能力的小工具），也能在本機、個人、工作區和遠端目錄找它們。像一只可攜式工具箱：工具可在不同工具櫃找到；若封條檢查失敗，箱子就先不接外部管線。安全邊界也加厚了：外掛會被更嚴格隔離；如果更新安全政策失敗，Codex 會拒絕網路連線。
body.en: Moving to another computer or workspace no longer means hunting down your add-ons again. You can install portable Agent Plugins and search local, personal, workspace, and remote catalogs for them. Think of a portable toolbox: its tools can be found in different tool cabinets; if the seal check fails, the box does not connect to external lines yet. The release also tightens plugin isolation and denies network access if a policy update fails.
